y-m-71-04.title: Ukuba sihlula macala omabini nge-a, ingaba b = c?
y-m-71-04.goal: Bonisa ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba iimveliso zamachaphaza ezilinganayo azenzi ii-vektha ezimbini zilingane, uze ufumane ukuba zingaphi eziseleyo xa kongezwa imeko ngobungakanani.
y-m-71-04.material: Ii-vektha zomphezulu zi-a = (2, 1) kunye ne-c = (1, 3). U-Jisu uthe, 'Kuba a · b = a · c, ukwahlula macala omabini nge-a kunika b = c.' (Ichaphaza lithetha imveliso yamachaphaza.) I-b inefom b = (b1, b2) kwaye amacandelo ayo ngamanani okwenyani.
y-m-71-04.thinking.0: Ukuvavanya ukuba imithetho yokubala ngamanani inokuthathelwa ngqo kwimveliso yamachaphaza ee-vektha
y-m-71-04.thinking.2: Ukucinga ngenani lezisombululo xa kongezwa imeko
y-m-71-04.prereq.0: Ingcamango: lo msebenzi usetelwe kwinqanaba eliphezulu lesikolo samabanga aphezulu, ukuze usonjululwe emva kokuba sele ufundile isifundo sokukhetha 'Geometry' (ii-conic section, ii-vektha zomphezulu, iisolidi kunye neekhowudinethi zesithuba); 'H3' ligama lobunzima kuphela kweli qela lemveliso kwaye alithethi ukuba isifundo sabelwe kwibanga elithile. Ifom yamacandelo ee-vektha zomphezulu, ukubala imveliso yamachaphaza ngamacandelo, ubungakanani be-vektha
y-m-71-04.s.s1.prompt: Yeyiphi indlela eqinisekileyo yokujonga ukuba isiphelo sika-Jisu 'b = c' sihlala sisebenza na?
y-m-71-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sombulula a · b = a · c ngamacandelo uze uyibhale njengolingano phakathi kwe-b1 ne-b2.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha i-b enye ehlangabezana nolo lingano uze uyithelekise ne-c.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.a: Beka ii-b ezininzi ubone ukuba zonke zi-b = c na
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.a: Ukuqokelela imizekelo nokujonga kuphela leyo ihambelana akunakubonisa 'rhoqo'. Ngokukodwa, imizekelo oyikhethayo isenokuthamba kwicala elinye.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.b: Jonga ukuba ekubeni a ingeyo i-vektha yezero, sinokwahlula macala omabini
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.b: Uthathele ngqo umthetho wokurhoxisa osetyenziswa ekuphindaphindeni kwamanani kwimveliso yamachaphaza. Imveliso yamachaphaza yinkqubo eguqula ii-vektha zibe linani.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.c: Khangela i-b ene-a · b = a · c kunye ne-b ≠ c
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.c: Usebenzise inyani yokuba ukuphula 'rhoqo', umzekelo omnye ohlangabezana nemeko kodwa onesiphelo esingalunganga uyanela.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.d: Kuqala thelekisa ukuba b ne-c zinobungakanani obufanayo na
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba nobungakanani obufanayo yimeko efunekayo ye-b = c, kodwa kufuneka uqale ujonge ukuba ilandela kwimeko enikiweyo na.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.explain: Ukuphula 'rhoqo iyasebenza', umzekelo omnye ohlangabezana nemeko a · b = a · c ngoxa b ≠ c uyanela.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.prompt: Ngenisa ii-b ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo b = (b1, b2) ezinamacandelo ezi-integer ezihlangabezana ne-a · b = a · c kodwa b ≠ c. (|b1| ≤ 5)
y-m-71-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala bala ixabiso le-a · c ngokubeka i-c, uze ubhale i-a · b ngamacandelo uze uwalinganise.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha i-b1 uze ujonge ukuba b2 igqitywa njani, emva koko jonga ukuba b yahlukile kwi-c.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.fail.c2: I-b ifana ne-c. Fumana i-vektha eyahlukileyo.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.explain: a · c = 2·1 + 1·3 = 5, ngoko kwanela ukuba 2b1 + b2 = 5. Zininzi ezifana nazo, ezifana ne-(0, 5), (2, 1), (3, −1). Zonke ezi b zinecandelo elifanayo kwicala le-a ne-c kwaye zahluke kuphela kwicandelo elime nkqo ku-a.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba wongeza ne-|b| = |c| (ubungakanani be-b bulingana nobungakanani be-c), zingaphi ii-b ewonke ezine-a · b = a · c kunye ne-b ≠ c? (Amacandelo ngamanani okwenyani.)
y-m-71-04.s.s3.hint.0: Beka i-b2 = 5 − 2b1 kwi-b1² + b2² = 10 ukwenza intetho ngo-b1.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.hint.1: Jonga ukuba i-c ngokwayo ikwizisombululo ezifunyenweyo uze uyisuse.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.a: Ucinge ukuba b = c yodwa. Sombulula izilingano ezimbini kunye uze ubale ukuba amaxabiso angaphi e-b1 aphuma.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.b: Uyibonile ukuba iimeko ezimbini zisondele ekugqibeni i-b. Ukuba uyisombulula ngqo, enye iyashiyeka ngaphandle kwe-b = c.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.c: Uyifanise nezisombululo ezi-2 zezilingano ezimbini. Ngaba ujonge ukuba enye yazo yi-c ngokwayo?
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.d: Uthathele isiphelo xa kukho imeko enye. Ekubeni kukho olunye ulingano, fumana indlela izisombululo eziguquka ngayo.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.explain: Ukudibanisa 2b1 + b2 = 5 kunye ne-b1² + b2² = 10 kunika (1, 3) kunye ne-(3, −1). I-(1, 3) yi-c ngokwayo, ngoko i-b kuphela eyahlukileyo kwi-c yi-(3, −1). Le b yi-vektha c ebonakaliswe ngaphesheya komgca okwicala le-a.

y-m-71-08.title: Ngokuxhomekeke kwisikhundla seliphuzu, mangaphi amathanjenti anokuzotywa?
y-m-71-08.goal: Qikelela uze uhlaziye inani lamathanjenti anokuzotywa ukusuka kwiphuzu elingaphandle, elikuyo, nelingaphakathi kwiparabola y² = 4x, uze uchaze ukuba ithanjenti yeyiphi eyilahlekileyo kwisisombululo esithatha ithambeka njengonobumba.
y-m-71-08.material: Cinga ngeparabola y² = 4x (y isikwere silingana ne-4x). Incopho ngu-O(0, 0). Sifuna ukufumana ukuba mangaphi imigca ethintelayo enokuzotywa kule parabola ukusuka kwiphuzu A kwiplani yee-koodinethi. Ukuba iphuzu likwiparabola, sibala umgca othintelayo odlula kuloo phuzu. Iinde azinazo iiyunithi.
y-m-71-08.thinking.1: Ukuhlaziya umgwebo wakho xa iphuzu elitsha livela
y-m-71-08.prereq.0: Ingcamango: lo msebenzi usetelwe kwinqanaba eliphezulu lesikolo esiphakamileyo, ukusonjululwa emva kokufunda sele isifundo sokukhetha 'Jiyomethri' (amacandelo e-conic, ii-vektha zeplani, izinto eziqinileyo nee-koodinethi zesithuba); 'H3' ilebheli yobunzima kuphela yale batshi yemveliso yaye ayithethi ukuba isifundo sinikwa ibanga elithile. Ifom esemgangathweni yeparabola, ulingano lothanjenti (ithanjenti enethambeka m inefom y = mx + 1/m), i-discriminant yolingano lwekhwadrathi
y-m-71-08.s.s1.prompt: Amanqaku adalulwa elinye ngexesha. Ngalo lonke ixesha, qikelela inani lamathanjenti anokuzotywa ukusuka kuloo phuzu.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.hint.0: Faka ii-koodinethi zeliphuzu kwi-y² = 4x uze uthelekise ukuba yeyiphi enkulu phakathi kwe-y² ne-4x.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ithanjenti enethambeka m njenge-y = mx + 1/m, faka ii-koodinethi zeliphuzu ukwenza ulingano ngokwe-m, uze uhlole umqondiso we-discriminant.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mangaphi amathanjenti anokuzotywa ukusuka ku-A ukuya kwiparabola?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Ithanjenti y = mx + 1/m edlula kwi-A(1, 3) yanelisa 3 = m + 1/m, oko kukuthi, m² − 3m + 1 = 0, ene-discriminant 5, elungileyo, ngoko zikho amathambeka amabini. Iphuzu likwingaphandle, ngoko zikho amathanjenti ama-2.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ucinge ukuba kukho ithanjenti enye kuphela. Vavanya ukuba ungawafumana na amathambeka amabini ahlukeneyo amathanjenti adlula kwiphuzu.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Awuzange wahlule ukuba iphuzu likwingaphandle okanye ngaphakathi kweparabola. Cinga ukuba amathanjenti anokuzotywa ukusuka kwicala elithini.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Inkumbulo yokuba kukho amathanjenti amabini ukusuka kwiphuzu elingaphandle nokuthelekisa isikhundla seliphuzu kuyahambelana.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Ithanjenti edlula kwi-B(1, 2) yanelisa 2 = m + 1/m, oko kukuthi, (m − 1)² = 0, ngoko likho ithambeka elinye kuphela (m = 1). Ukusuka kwiphuzu elikwiparabola kukho ithanjenti e-1.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ugwebe ukuba ukusuka kwiphuzu elikwiparabola kukho kuphela ithanjenti kuloo phuzu.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uthwale isigqibo sechaphazelo elingaphandle. Eli chaphazelo likwipharabholi, ngoko indawo itshintshile.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ukusuka kwichaphazelo elikwipharabholi kukho umgca othe tyaba kuloo ndawo. Hlola ukuba ikho na imigca ethe tyaba edlula kwichaphazelo.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zingaphi imigca ethe tyaba enokuzotywa ukusuka ku-C?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Umgca othe tyaba odlula kwi-C(4, 1) wanelisa 1 = 4m + 1/m, oko kukuthi 4m² − m + 1 = 0, yaye i-discriminant yi-1 − 16 < 0, ngoko akukho mthambeka. Ukusuka kwichaphazelo elingaphakathi, akukho mgca othe tyaba onokuzotywa.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uthwale isigqibo sechaphazelo elikwipharabholi. Eli chaphazelo alikwipharabholi.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ugwebe ukuba lichaphazelo elingaphakathi kwipharabholi, ngoko akukho migca ethe tyaba konke.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uthwale isigqibo sechaphazelo elingaphandle. Thelekisa ubukhulu be-4x ne-y² ukuhlola ukuba lingaphakathi na.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.reflect: Amanani eemigca ethe tyaba kumachaphazelo amathathu ayi-2, 1 kunye 0. Ungayichaza njani indawo yechaphazelo ngokuthelekisa ubukhulu be-y² ne-4x? Cinga nokuba olu thelekiso lunxulumana njani nophawu lwe-discriminant.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.prompt: Zingaphi imigca ethe tyaba enokuzotywa kwipharabholi ukusuka kwichaphazelo D(0, 3)? Fumana ubhale yonke imigca ethe tyaba, uze uthelekise nokuba oku kuhambelana nesiphumo sesisombululo esimisela umthambeka njenge-m.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuba ulingano a·m² − b·m + 1 = 0 ku-m lutshintsha njani xa i-x-coordinate ye-D ingu-0.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.hint.1: Bala ukuba zingaphi imigca ethe tyaba ofumene kwibinzana ku-m, uze uzobe imigca edlula kwichaphazelo D kumacala ahlukeneyo ukubona ukuba zikho imigca eyongezelelweyo edibana nepharabholi kwichaphazelo elinye kuphela.

y-m-71-08.s.s2.model.1: Zimbini imigca ethe tyaba. Oku kunokwenzeka kuba ichaphazelo D lingaphandle kwepharabholi, yaye omnye yi-x = 0 nomnye yi-y = (1/3)x + 3. x = 0 ayinakubhalwa ngefom y = mx + n, ngoko iphoswa sisisombululo esisebenzisa umthambeka.

y-m-71-01.title: Ingaba kukho ichaphaza elinye kuphela elikumgama we-10 ukusuka kwi-focus?
y-m-71-01.goal: Kwisisombululo esifumana amachaphaza usebenzisa imeko yomgama ukusuka kwichaphaza elikwiparabola ukuya kwi-focus, fumana umgca ophosise ukulinganisa, uze usebenze ngokwakho ukuba mangaphi amachaphaza anelisa imeko zizonke.
y-m-71-01.material: Cinga ngeparabola y² = 8x (funda: y isikwere silingana no-x isibhozo) kwi-plane yeekhowudinethi. Vumela u-F abe yi-focus yale parabola, kwaye ichaphaza P(x, y) libe lichaphaza elikwiparabola. Umfundi wacombulula ingxaki yokufumana onke amachaphaza P anomgama PF olingana ne-10 njengoko kubonisiwe ngezantsi. Iiyunithi zeekhowudinethi zonke ziyafana, kwaye ubude babhalwa ngaphandle kweeyunithi.
y-m-71-01.thinking.1: Ukusebenza ukuba mangaphi amachaphaza anelisa imeko
y-m-71-01.thinking.2: Ukugweba ukuba isisombululo sikhona na ngoluhlu lwamaxabiso anokwenzeka
y-m-71-01.prereq.0: Ingqikelelo: lo msebenzi usetwe kwinqanaba eliphezulu lesikolo samabanga aphezulu, ukucombululwa emva kokufunda isifundo esikhethiweyo 'iGeometry' (ii-conic sections, ii-vektha zeplane, iisolidi nokuhlanganisa kwesithuba); 'H3' yilebhile yobunzima yeli qela lemveliso kuphela kwaye ayithethi ukuba isifundo sabelwe kwibanga elithile. Ingcaciso yeparabola (i-focus ne-directrix), i-focus ne-directrix yemo y²=4px, ifomula yomgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini
y-m-71-01.s.s1.hint.0: Faka ibinzana lomgca ngamnye ngqo kumgca olandelayo, uze uthelekise ukuba inani leemeko lincitshisiwe na xa uhamba ukusuka komgca wangaphambili uya kowasemva.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala onke amaxabiso anokuthatyathwa ngu-y xa x = 8 ifakwa kulingano lweparabola.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukusuka kwimo y² = 4px, 4p = 8, ngoko p = 2, i-focus F yi-(2, 0), kwaye i-directrix yi-x = −2.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.1: Kwichaphaza P(x, y) elikwiparabola, PF ilingana nomgama ukusuka ku-P ukuya kwi-directrix, ngoko PF = x + 2.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.2: PF = 10, ngoko x + 2 = 10, oko kukuthi, x = 8.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.3: y² = 8 · 8 = 64, ngoko y = 8, kwaye ichaphaza elilodwa elanelisa imeko yi-P(8, 8).
y-m-71-01.s.s1.explain: Imigca 1 ukuya ku-3 ichanekile. Kumgca 4, ukuba y² = 64 ngoko y = 8 okanye y = −8. Iparabola ilinganayo malunga ne-eksisi ye-x, ngoko omabini amachaphaza (8, 8) kunye (8, −8) anelisa imeko. Umgca 5 uthathe nje ukushiywa komgca 4.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.prompt: Ngenisa amachaphaza angama-2 ahlukeneyo P(x, y) akwiparabola aneekhowudinethi ezipheleleyo ezanelisa PF = 10. (I-focus F yi-(2, 0).)
y-m-71-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ubudlelwane phakathi kuka-x no-y njengolingano usebenzisa imeko yokuba ichaphaza likwiparabola.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha u-x omnye, hlola ukuba u-y uphuma enani eliphelele na, uze ubale ngqo umgama ukusuka kuloo chaphaza ukuya ku-F.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.explain: Amachaphaza kuphela ahlangabezana nemeko zombini yi-(8, 8) kunye ne-(8, −8). I-x ilungisiwe njengexabiso elinye kwaye uphawu lwe-y kuphela lunamathuba amabini.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.prompt: Mangaphi amachaphaza P kwiparabola enye anee-PF = 1?
y-m-71-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala i-PF njengentetho ngo-x uze ujonge uluhlu lwamaxabiso e-x anokuthathwa ngamachaphaza aseparaboleni.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bala ngqo umgama ukusuka kwincopho O(0, 0) ukuya ku-F.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.a: Ukuba ubala i-PF kwincopho ngqo, ayiyi-1. Uqikelele ichaphaza elisondele kakhulu ungabalanga.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.b: Mabini. Amachaphaza amabini alinganayo malunga ne-eksisi ye-x
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.b: Uthathe isiphelo esithi 'amachaphaza amabini alinganayo' kwinyathelo elidlulileyo njengoko linjalo. Kufuneka uqale ujonge ukuba ixabiso lika-x liyenzeka na.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.c: Intetho PF = x + 2 ikuvumela ukuba ugqibe uluhlu lwamaxabiso anokwenzeka. Le ayiyo imeko yokunqongophala kolwazi.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.o.d: Akukho. I-PF ihlala ingaphantsi kwe-2 ubuncinane
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.d: I-x + 2 iba yi-2 kwelona xabiso lincinci anokuthatha i-x. Esi sisigwebo esihlolisise uluhlu olunokwenzeka lomgama.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.explain: PF = x + 2, kwaye kwiparabola x ≥ 0, ngoko PF ≥ 2. Ukuze PF = 1 sifuna x = −1, kodwa ke y² = −8 kwaye akukho y yokwenyani. Imeko yomgama inokungabi nasisombululo konke.

y-m-71-02.title: Ngaba amachaphaza anesixa somgama esingatshintshiyo rhoqo yi-ellipse?
y-m-71-02.topic: Inkcazo ye-ellipse (isixa somgama ukuya kumachaphaza amabini)
y-m-71-02.goal: Fumana imeko efunekayo ukuze iseti yamachaphaza anesixa somgama esingatshintshiyo ukuya kumachaphaza amabini ibe yi-ellipse, uze uthi sisiphi isimo esiphumayo xa imeko inqongophele okanye isemda.
y-m-71-02.material: Kumphezulu wekhowudinethi kukho amachaphaza amabini F(−4, 0) kunye ne-F'(4, 0) (funda: F kunye ne-F prime). Umgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini yi-8. Ichaphaza P(x, y) lihamba ukuze PF + PF' = s. Apha s yi-constant eqinisekileyo, kwaye ubude babhalwa ngaphandle kweeyunithi.
y-m-71-02.prereq.0: Ingcamango: lo msebenzi usetelwe kwinqanaba eliphezulu lesikolo samabanga aphezulu, ukuze usonjululwe emva kokuba sele ufundile isifundo sokukhetha 'Geometry' (ii-conic section, ii-vektha zomphezulu, iisolidi kunye neekhowudinethi zesithuba); 'H3' ligama lobunzima kuphela kweli qela lemveliso kwaye alithethi ukuba isifundo sabelwe kwibanga elithile. Inkcazo kunye nefom esemgangathweni ye-ellipse, umgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini, ubudlelwane phakathi kobude bamacala amathathu kanxantathu
y-m-71-02.s.s1.prompt: Singayazi ixabiso le-s, ngaba singathi isimo esizotywa lichaphaza P yi-ellipse?
y-m-71-02.s.s1.hint.0: Beka amaxabiso ambalwa ku-s uze ufumane ukuba ichaphaza elinjalo P likhona kwaphela na.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuba ngowuphi ubudlelwane obukho phakathi kobude bamacala amathathu xa amachaphaza P, F no-F' edityaniswa enza unxantathu.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.a: Asinakuthi. Ukuba s ngu-8 okanye ngaphantsi, ayiyo i-ellipse
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.a: Ukhomboile ukuba, ngaphandle kwenkcazo, s kufuneka ithelekiswe nomgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.b: Singathi. Inqaku lokuba isixa asitshintshi, rhoqo yi-ellipse
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.b: Ukhumbule inkcazo kuphela ukuya ku 'isixa asitshintshi'. Ngaba uke wathelekisa ubungakanani besixa nomgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini?
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.c: Asinakuthi. Kugqitywa yindawo yamachaphaza amabini kuphela
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.c: I-s yi-constant ethe tye kwaye ichaphazela isimo. Vavanya okuguquka xa utshintsha i-s.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.d: Singathi. Nokuba s yinani elingakanani eliqinisekileyo, P ikhona
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.d: Uthathe 'P ikhona' kunye no 'yi-ellipse' njengento enye. Nokuba ikhona, isimo sinokungabi yi-ellipse.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.explain: PF + PF' ≥ FF' = 8, ngoko ukuba s < 8 akukho chaphaza linjalo P, kwaye ukuba s = 8 amachaphaza asecandelweni FF'. Yi-ellipse kuphela xa s > 8. Ngoko kufuneka ulwazi olungakumbi ngo-s.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.prompt: Xa s = 10, ngenisa amachaphaza ama-2 ahlukeneyo P(x, y) anekhowudinethi ezi-integer ahlangabezana ne-PF + PF' = 10.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokukhetha amachaphaza kwii-eksisi uze ubale i-PF ne-PF' ngalinye.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ukuba isixa semigama emibini yechaphaza olikhethileyo sikhulu kune-10, hambisa ichaphaza lisondele kwiifokhasi ezimbini; ukuba sincinci, lihambise lisondele kude.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Isixa semigama ukuya kumachaphaza amabini yi-10.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Isixa semigama ukuya kumachaphaza amabini asiyi-10.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.explain: Amachaphaza kuphela anekhowudinethi ezi-integer ngamachaphaza amane (5, 0), (−5, 0), (0, 3) kunye ne-(0, −3). Ukuqala kwii-eksisi kukuvumela ukuba udibanise imigama ngoko nangoko. Kukho amachaphaza amaninzi ngakumbi kwi-ellipse angezizo ii-integer.
y-m-71-02.s.s3.prompt: Xa s = 8, sisiphi isimo esenziwa ngawo onke amachaphaza P ahlangabezana ne-PF + PF' = 8?
y-m-71-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bala i-PF + PF' kwichaphaza elisecandelweni FF' (umzekelo imvelaphi).
y-m-71-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bala isixa kwichaphaza elingasecandelweni (umzekelo (0, 1)) uze ulithelekise ne-8.
y-m-71-02.s.s3.r.a: Ukuba isixa si-8, silingana nomgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini. Fumana ukuba isixa kufuneka sibe sikhulu kunaleyo ukuze ibe yi-ellipse.
y-m-71-02.s.s3.r.b: Bala isixa kwenye indawo ecandelweni. Sisixa esiyintoni kwindawo ephakathi O(0, 0)?
y-m-71-02.s.s3.r.c: Ukuba P isecandelweni, PF + PF' ilingana kanye ne-8. Uyahlule ityala lomda.
y-m-71-02.s.s3.r.d: Bala isixa ngqo kwichaphaza elinye elisecandelweni. Awuzange uvavanye ukuba ngokwenene akukho machaphaza.
y-m-71-02.s.s3.explain: Ukuba P isecandelweni FF', ngoko PF + PF' = 8, kwaye ukuba ingasecandelweni, isixa sikhulu kune-8 ngenxa yobudlelwane phakathi kobude bamacala amathathu kanxantathu. Ngoko isimo xa s = 8 sisicandelo.

y-m-71-03.title: Ukuba idibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela, ingaba yithanjenti?
y-m-71-03.goal: Zifumanele ityala apho ukwenza ngokubanzi 'umgca odibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela yithanjenti' kuphula kwi-hyperbola, uze uchaze isizathu, ulidibanise nee-asymptote.
y-m-71-03.material: Cinga nge-hyperbola H: x²/9 − y²/16 = 1 (funda: x isikwere phezu kwe-9 ukususa y isikwere phezu kwe-16 ilingana ne-1). Ii-asymptote ze-H zi-y = (4/3)x kunye ne-y = −(4/3)x. Imigca ibhalwa ngefom px + qy = r (p, q no-r ziiinteger kwaye p no-q azizozonke ngu-0). Umfundi uthe, 'Kwi-ellipse, umgca odibana nayo kwichaphaza elinye kuphela yithanjenti. Ngoko kwi-H nayo, umgca odibana nayo kwichaphaza elinye kuphela kufuneka ube yithanjenti.'
y-m-71-03.thinking.0: Ukuchonga iimeko zomzekelo ochasayo wokwenza ngokubanzi
y-m-71-03.thinking.2: Ukuchaza umahluko phakathi kwethanjenti nomgca odibana kwichaphaza elinye
y-m-71-03.prereq.0: Ingcamango: lo msebenzi usetelwe kwinqanaba eliphezulu lesikolo samabanga aphezulu, ukuze usonjululwe emva kokuba sele ufundile isifundo sokukhetha 'Geometry' (ii-conic section, ii-vektha zomphezulu, iisolidi kunye neekhowudinethi zesithuba); 'H3' ligama lobunzima kuphela kweli qela lemveliso kwaye alithethi ukuba isifundo sabelwe kwibanga elithile. Ifom esemgangathweni kunye nee-asymptote ze-hyperbola, intsingiselo ye-discriminant xa umgca kunye ne-conic zidityaniswa
y-m-71-03.s.s1.prompt: Ungawufuna umgca onjani ukuvavanya ukuba isibhengezo salo mfundi sihlala silunge kwi-H nayo?
y-m-71-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala isibhengezo sahlulwe sibe 'ukuba imeko A ngoko isiphelo B'. A no-B ziyintoni?
y-m-71-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba isibhengezo siyaphuka ukuba nje kukho umzekelo omnye.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.o.a: Nawuphi na umgca odibana ne-H kumachaphaza amabini ahlukeneyo
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.a: Isibhengezo sijongene nemigca edibana 'kwichaphaza elinye kuphela'. Umgca odibana kumachaphaza amabini awusiyo into yesibhengezo.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.o.b: Umgca ongeyonthanjenti odibana ne-H kwichaphaza elinye kuphela
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.b: Uzamile ukufumana umgca ohlangabezana nemeko yokuqala 'idibana kwichaphaza elinye' kodwa ophula imeko yesibini 'yithanjenti'.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.c: Ithanjenti edibana kwichaphaza elinye ngumzekelo ohambelana nesibhengezo. Ukuqokelela imizekelo emininzi enjalo akunakukuxelela ukuba isibhengezo asilunganga.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.d: Umgca ongadibani ne-H awuhlangabezani nemeko yesibhengezo (ukudibana kwichaphaza elinye) ekuqaleni.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.explain: Ukubonisa ukuba 'ukuba A ngoko B' asilunganga, ufuna umzekelo ohlangabezana ne-A kodwa ongahlangabezani ne-B. Apha A 'idibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela' kwaye B 'yithanjenti'.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.prompt: Phakathi kwemigca px + qy = r, ngenisa imigca ema-2 eyahlukeneyo edibana ne-H kwichaphaza elinye kanye kodwa engeyiyo ithanjenti. (|p|, |q| ≤ 20, |r| ≤ 100. Umgca ofanayo obhalwe ngee-integer ezilinganayo ubalwa njengomgca omnye.)
y-m-71-03.s.s2.hint.0: Phinda ubhale umgca ngefom y = mx + k uze uwubeke kulingano lwe-H; bala ukuba ikhona na i-m eyenza ikoyifishenti ye-x² kwintetho ngo-x ilingane no-0.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa i-m enjalo nethambeka lee-asymptote ze-H, uze ubhale ithambeka njengomlinganiselo we-p no-q ukuze p no-q zibe ziiinteger.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ukuba p no-q zombini zi-0, ayingomgca.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Gcina p no-q zingaphezulu kwe-20 ubuninzi kwaye r ingaphezulu kwe-100 ubuninzi ngexabiso eliphelele.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Ngumgca odibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela (imeko yethambeka).
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Lo mgca awuloluhlobo lodibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela (okanye yithanjenti).
y-m-71-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Awudluli kwimvelaphi, ngoko ngokwenene udibana ne-H.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Ukuba r = 0, yi-asymptote ngokwayo kwaye ayidibani ne-H.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo: 4x + 3y = 6 udibana ne-H kwichaphaza elinye kuphela kodwa ayiyonthanjenti. Oku kungenxa yokuba ithambeka lalo mgca lifana nethambeka le-asymptote y = −(4/3)x. 5x + 3y = 9 okanye x = 3 zidibana kwichaphaza elinye kwaye ziithanjenti, ngoko azizizo imizekelo echasayo.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ngezivakalisi ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-3 isizathu sokuba umgca owukhethileyo ungeyonthanjenti nokuba udibana ne-H kwichaphaza elinye kuphela, usebenzisa ulingano lomgca wakho okanye i-asymptote nethambeka.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala bhala ngesivakalisi esinye ukuba lelipi ixabiso kulingano lalo mgca elifana nelee-asymptote.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.hint.1: Yongeza umgca omnye ngokuba izinga lentetho ngo-x liguquka njani.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba inkcazo yam iquka ulingano okanye ithambeka lomgca endiwukhethileyo?
y-m-71-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ndiwahlulile ngamagama am ukuba 'idibana kwichaphaza elinye' kunye 'yithanjenti' azifani?
y-m-71-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ndicinge ngendlela inkqubo yokulingana ibiya kuba yahlukile ukuba ibiyithanjenti?
y-m-71-03.s.s3.model.0: Umgca 4x + 3y = 6 unethambeka elifana ne-asymptote y = −(4/3)x, ngoko iyahambelana. Xa ubekwa endaweni, ikoyifishenti ye-x² iyanyamalala kwaye iba lulingano lomgca olunesisombululo esinye kuphela, ngoko idibana kwichaphaza elinye kuphela, kodwa ayilulingano lwekhwadrathi olunengcambu ephindiweyo, ngoko ayiyonthanjenti.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.model.1: Umgca ohambelana ne-asymptote udibana ne-H kwichaphaza elinye, kodwa wahlukile kwithanjenti, ene-discriminant engu-0. Ithanjenti idibana ne-H kwichaphaza lokuthinta kwaye ihlala kwicala elinye lejika, ngoxa lo mgca unqumla kwisebe elinye le-H.

y-m-71-06.title: Mangaphi amanqaku anelisa iimeko zomgama olinganayo?
y-m-71-06.topic: Imigama ukusuka kwiphuzu ukuya kwii-eksisi nasezi-plani kwii-koodinethi zesithuba
y-m-71-06.goal: Hlula umgama ukuya kwi-eksisi nomgama ukuya kwiplani yee-koodinethi kwii-koodinethi zesithuba, uze uyile amanqaku anelisa zombini iimeko zomgama ngaxeshanye.
y-m-71-06.material: Kwii-koodinethi zesithuba i-x-eksisi, i-y-eksisi ne-z-eksisi zime nkqo omnye komnye, yaye iplani ye-xy yiplani z = 0. Kukho iphuzu P(3, 4, 12). 'Umgama ukusuka kwiphuzu ukuya kwi-eksisi yekoodinethi' bubude bomgca othe nkqo ukusuka kwiphuzu ukuya kwi-eksisi, 'umgama ukusuka kwiphuzu ukuya kwiplani yekoodinethi' bubude bomgca othe nkqo ukuya kwiplani. Iinde zibhalwa ngaphandle kweeyunithi.
y-m-71-06.thinking.0: Ukwahlula umgama ukuya kwi-eksisi nomgama ukuya kwiplani
y-m-71-06.thinking.1: Ukuyila amanqaku anelisa iimeko ezimbini ngaxeshanye
y-m-71-06.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ubudlelwane phakathi kwenani leemeko nemigangatho yenkululeko
y-m-71-06.prereq.0: Ingcamango: lo msebenzi usetelwe kwinqanaba eliphezulu lesikolo esiphakamileyo, ukusonjululwa emva kokufunda sele isifundo sokukhetha 'Jiyomethri' (amacandelo e-conic, ii-vektha zeplani, izinto eziqinileyo nee-koodinethi zesithuba); 'H3' ilebheli yobunzima kuphela yale batshi yemveliso yaye ayithethi ukuba isifundo sinikwa ibanga elithile. Ii-koodinethi zesithuba (ii-koodinethi zeliphuzu), umgama phakathi kwamanqaku amabini, intsingiselo yee-eksisi zee-koodinethi neeplani zee-koodinethi
y-m-71-06.s.s1.prompt: Ungowuphi umgama ukusuka kwiphuzu P(3, 4, 12) ukuya kwi-z-eksisi?
y-m-71-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ii-koodinethi zeliphuzu elikwi-z-eksisi elinayo i-z-koodinethi efanayo ne-P.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa kwiliphi icandelo apho umahluko phakathi kweliphuzu ne-P uvela khona.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.a: Usebenzise inyaniso yokuba iphuzu elisondele kakhulu kwi-z-eksisi li-(0, 0, 12) waza wafumana umgama kumacandelo e-x ne-y kuphela.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.b: Ufunde i-z-koodinethi ngqo. I-z-koodinethi inxulumene nomgama ukuya kwiplani ye-xy.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.c: Ufumene umgama ukuya kwimvelaphi. Imvelaphi ayiyo indawo esondele kakhulu kwi-eksisi.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.d: Wongeze nje i-x ne-y. Umgama bubude bomgca othe nkqo, ngoko kufuneka usebenzise ithiyori kaPythagoras.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.explain: Iphuzu elisondele kakhulu ku-P kwi-z-eksisi li-(0, 0, 12), yaye umgama ngu-√(3² + 4²) = 5. I-z-koodinethi 12 ngumgama ukuya kwiplani ye-xy.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.prompt: Faka amanqaku ama-4 ahlukeneyo Q(x, y, z) anee-koodinethi eziziinani eziphelele anomgama ukuya kwi-z-eksisi ongu-5 nomgama ukuya kwiplani ye-xy ongu-12.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuba umgama 5 ukuya kwi-z-eksisi uba yintetho eyiphi ngokwe-x ne-y, uze ufumane iibini ezininzi zeenani eziphelele ezayanelisayo.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuba umgama 12 ukuya kwiplani ye-xy uvumela amaxabiso e-z amangaphi.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.explain: Kukho iibini ezili-12 zeenani eziphelele ezanelisa x² + y² = 25, yaye i-z ingu-12 okanye −12, ngoko zikho amanqaku ama-24 anee-koodinethi eziziinani eziphelele ngokubanzi. Iimeko ezimbini zinamathelaniswa ngokwahlukileyo kwii-koodinethi ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.prompt: Chaza, usebenzisa amanqaku owenzileyo njengemizekelo, isizathu sokuba amanqaku amaninzi kangaka anelise iimeko nangona zimbini kuphela. Bhala nokuba indlela yokukhetha i-x ne-y yahlukile njani kwindlela yokukhetha i-z.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuba x² + y² = 25 liseti yamanqaku athini kwiplani ye-xy.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuba imeko ye-z ivumela amaxabiso e-z amangaphi.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ndichaze ngokwahlukileyo imeko emisela i-x ne-y kunye nemeko emisela i-z?
y-m-71-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndibandakanye ubuncinane i-koodinethi enye yeliphuzu endilenzile njengomzekelo?
y-m-71-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ndicinge ukuba amanqaku aya kuba mangaphi ukuba ii-koodinethi bezingafuni ukuba ziziinani eziphelele?

Kukho amanqaku amaninzi anjalo, njenge-(3, 4) okanye (4, −3), yaye ukuba umgama ukuya kwiplani ye-xy ungu-12, ke z ngu-12 okanye −12, iimeko ezimbini, ngoko amanqaku aya ephindaphindeka.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.model.1: Kufuneka simisele amaxabiso amathathu x, y kunye no-z, kodwa zimbini kuphela iimeko, ngesixa se-x² ne-y² nangexabiso eliphelele le-z, ngoko iphuzu linokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo. Ngaphandle kwe-3² + 4² = 25 kukho amanqaku ane-5² + 0² = 25, yaye i-z ingu-12 okanye −12, ngoko zikho amanqaku ahlukeneyo anokuba ngama-24.

y-m-71-05.title: Ukuba uluhlu lweekoyifishenti luyatshintsha, sisiphi isimo esizotywa lichaphaza?
y-m-71-05.goal: Qikelela ukuba isimo esizotywa lichaphaza P siyatshintsha ngeemeko zeekoyifishenti x no-y kwi-OP = x·OA + y·OB, qinisekisa ukuba ummandla uba tyaba xa ii-vektha ezimbini ziyahambelana, uze wakhe wena amachaphaza ahambelana nemeko yendawo.
y-m-71-05.material: Vumela O ibe yimvelaphi yomphezulu wekhowudinethi, uze ubhale indawo yechaphaza P njenge-vektha OP = x·OA + y·OB (funda: i-vektha OP ilingana no-x amaxesha i-vektha OA kudityaniswe no-y amaxesha i-vektha OB). I-x ne-y ngamanani okwenyani kwaye iimeko ziyatshintsha kwinyathelo ngalinye. Ubude babhalwa ngaphandle kweeyunithi.
y-m-71-05.thinking.0: Ukuqikelela kwakhona isimo xa iimeko ziguquka
y-m-71-05.thinking.1: Ukucinga ngendlela ukuhambelana kwee-vektha ezimbini kuchaphazela ngayo ummandla
y-m-71-05.prereq.0: Ingcamango: lo msebenzi usetelwe kwinqanaba eliphezulu lesikolo samabanga aphezulu, ukuze usonjululwe emva kokuba sele ufundile isifundo sokukhetha 'Geometry' (ii-conic section, ii-vektha zomphezulu, iisolidi kunye neekhowudinethi zesithuba); 'H3' ligama lobunzima kuphela kweli qela lemveliso kwaye alithethi ukuba isifundo sabelwe kwibanga elithile. Ifom yamacandelo ee-vektha zomphezulu, iziphindaphindi zeskhala nokudibanisa, umgca odlula kumachaphaza amabini, indawo ye-parallelogram
y-m-71-05.s.s1.prompt: Iimeko namachaphaza ayavezwa inyathelo nenyathelo. Kwinyathelo ngalinye, qikelela isimo (okanye ummandla) osizotywa ngu-P.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, khetha izibini ezimbini okanye ezintathu (x, y) ezihlangabezana neemeko uze ubale ngqo iikhowudinethi ze-P.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kwinyathelo lesi-3, thelekisa amacandelo ukuze ubone ukuba bubuphi ubudlelwane obukho phakathi kwe-OA ne-OB.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.info: A(2, 0), B(0, 2), kwaye x no-y zonke ngamanani okwenyani ahlangabezana ne-x + y = 1.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.after: P = (2x, 2y) kwaye x + y = 1, ngoko amanqaku akumgca x + y = 2. I-x ne-y zinokuba negatifu, ngoko ngumgca wonke u-AB.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ucinge ngayo kubandakanywa nenyaniso yokuba i-x ne-y zinokuba negatifu.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ucinge kuphela ngeemeko apho i-x ne-y zingu-0 okanye ngaphezulu. Imeko ayinasithintelo kwimiqondiso.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: x + y = 1 ulingano olunye, ngoko alunakuzalisa inxalenye ebanzi yeplani. Sebenza ukuba ulingano lushiya imigangatho emingaphi yenkululeko.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Yongeza enye imeko kwi-A ne-B ezifanayo. x + y = 1 kunye ne-x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Iphuzu elifana no-x = 2, y = −1 liyashiywa kuba liphula i-y ≥ 0. Amanqaku asalayo ngala ane-x ne-y ubuncinane u-0 kunye nesixa 1, oko kukuthi, icandelo u-AB. Kuchanekile ukunciphisa uqikelelo lwenyathelo langaphambili ukuze lihambelane nemeko.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Awuhlolanga ukuba yimiphi imikhondo imeko entsha ewasusayo. I-y yintoni xa x = 2?
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Gwebe ukuba kuseleyo kuphela iimeko apho iikoyifishenti zingenguzo negatifu, kushiya kuphela inxalenye phakathi kwe-A ne-B.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Vavanya ukuba amanqaku apho i-x iphakathi kwe-0 ne-1 nawo asanelisa imeko.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Tshintsha ii-vektha zibe yi-A(2, 1) kunye ne-B(4, 2), yaye imeko yi-0 ≤ x ≤ 1, 0 ≤ y ≤ 1. (Akukho meko ye-x + y = 1.)
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Indawo yommandla apho i-P ihamba kuwo yintoni?
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.after: OB = 2·OA, ngoko P = (x + 2y)·OA. x + 2y ihluka ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-3, ngoko ummandla lulwandle ukusuka kwimvelaphi ukuya ku-(6, 3), yaye indawo yawo ingu-0. Xa ii-vektha ziyafana, i-parallelogram iba tyaba.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ubonile ukuba B = 2A, ngoko ii-vektha ezimbini zinecala elifanayo.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ucinge ukuba yinxande kuba ii-vektha ezimbini zime nkqo. Awuhlolanga i-engile phakathi kwee-vektha ezimbini.

y-m-71-05.s.s3.r.d: Uqonde ukuba leliphi icandelo elimisela indawo ngokwesiseko nobude bomfanekiso.
y-m-71-05.s.s3.explain: U-OA ukwi-eksisi ye-x, ngoko isiseko singu-3 yaye ubude ngumgama |b2| ukusuka ku-B ukuya kwi-eksisi ye-x. Ukutshintsha i-b1 kutyhala u-B ngokuhambelana ne-eksisi ye-x, ngoko ubude abutshintshi.

y-m-71-07.title: Ukuba umgca umi nkqo kwimigca emibini, ngaba umi nkqo nakwiplani?
y-m-71-07.goal: Fumana imeko elahlekileyo kumgwebo othi 'ukuba umgca umi nkqo kwimigca emibini kwiplani, umi nkqo kuloo plani', uze wakhe ngee-koodinethi umzekelo ochasayo apho imeko ilahlekile.
y-m-71-07.material: Kwii-koodinethi zesithuba iplani ye-xy α yiplani z = 0. Umgca m1 yi-x-eksisi enevektha yecala (1, 0, 0), yaye umgca m2 ngumgca odlula kwiphuzu (0, 1, 0) ohambelana ne-x-eksisi onevektha yecala (2, 0, 0). Yomibini imigca ikwi-α. Vumela ivektha yecala lomgca l ibe yi-d = (d1, d2, d3) (hayi ivektha engu-zero), yaye umfundi wasombulula ngokuthi, 'l imi nkqo kuzo zombini m1 ne-m2, ngoko imi nkqo kwi-α.'

Ifom yamacandelo nemveliso yamachaphaza yee-vektha kwii-koodinethi zesithuba, ukuma nkqo nokuhambelana kwemigca emibini, intsingiselo yomgca omi nkqo kwiplani

y-m-71-07.s.s2.prompt: Faka ii-vektha zecala ezi-3 ezineekhomponenti eziziinani eziphelele, ezinecala elahlukileyo, zemigca l apho i-d imi nkqo kwiivektha zecala ze-m1 kunye ne-m2 kodwa l ingemi nkqo kwi-α. (|d2|, |d3| ≤ 5. Icala elifanayo libalwa njengelinye.)

y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.a: Imi nkqo nakkomnye umgca kwi-α ohambelana ne-x-eksisi
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.a: Umgca onecala elifanayo ne-m1 kunye ne-m2 awunikeli ulingano olutsha. Thelekisa ukuba uphethe ulwazi olufanayo nemigca emibini yangaphambili.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.b: Isikhundla seliphuzu asitshintshi ulingano lwevektha yecala. Ufuna ulwazi ngecala, hayi ngeliphuzu eliyidlulayo.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.c: Imi nkqo nakumgca kwi-α ongahambelani ne-x-eksisi
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.c: Uqonde ukuba ufuna ulwazi ngomgca onecala elahlukileyo kwiplani. Imigca emibini engahambelaniyo kwiplani enye idibana kwiphuzu elinye.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.d: Ukuba nephuzu lokudibana lulwazi ngesikhundla. Alunikeli ulingano olutsha ngecala.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.explain: Ukuba imi nkqo kwimigca emibini engahambelaniyo kwiplani, imi nkqo kwiplani. Umzekelo, ukuba imi nkqo nakwicala le-y-eksisi (0, 1, 0), ke d2 = 0 kwaye d = (0, 0, d3).

y-m-71-09.title: Xa kuqikelelwa, ingaba indawo i-cosθ amaxesha okanye i-cos²θ amaxesha?
y-m-71-09.goal: Vavanya enye yeemodeli ezimbini ngamanani ngomzobo othile, uze ucacise kutheni isizathu esithi 'onke amacala ayancipha' singalunganga ngokwahlula amacala ahambelana nomgca apho iiplani ezimbini zidibana khona kwamathe nkqo kuwo.
y-m-71-09.material: Kwii-coordinates zesithuba, unxantathu ABC une-vertices A(0, 0, 0), B(4, 0, 0), C(0, 4, 4). I-engile θ phakathi kweplani yalo nxantathu ne-xy-plane i-45°, kwaye cos45° ≈ 0.707. Ithunzi (iprojekthi ethe nkqo) yalo nxantathu eliwiselwe ngokuthe nkqo kwi-xy-plane unxantathu one-vertices A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C'(0, 4). UJihu wathi, 'Ubude buncipha bufikelele kwi-cosθ amaxesha, ngoko zombini ububanzi nokuphakama kuyancipha, yaye indawo iba yi-cos²θ amaxesha,' yaye uSeoa wathi, 'Indawo iba yi-cosθ amaxesha.' Ubude bubhalwa ngaphandle kweeyunithi.
y-m-71-09.prereq.0: Isicingelo: lo msebenzi umiselwe kwinqanaba eliphezulu lesikolo samabanga aphezulu, ukusonjululwa emva kokufunda sele isifundo sokukhetha 'Geometry' (iingxenye ze-conic, ii-vector zeplani, izinto eziqinileyo nee-coordinates zesithuba); 'H3' ligama lobunzima kuphela lale ngxubakaxaka yokuvelisa yaye alithethi ukuba isifundo sabelwe kwibanga elithile. Ii-coordinates zesithuba, i-engile phakathi kweeplani ezimbini, intsingiselo yeprojekthi ethe nkqo kunye neengcamango ezisisiseko zobude nendawo eziqikelelweyo
y-m-71-09.s.s1.prompt: Indawo kanxantathu ABC yi-8√2 ≈ 11.31 yaye indawo yeprojekthi yi-8. Lo mzekelo omnye usixelela ntoni ngamabango amabini?

y-m-71-09.s.s1.r.b: Uqinisekise ukuba iyavumelana nemodeli kaSeoa waza wacinga nangomda womzekelo omnye.
